issues.description: The problem statement / UML specify Pneumatic.raisePressure(pressureIncrease: int) but the solution implementation declares raisePressure(double pressureIncrease). This parameter type mismatch between the specification and the provided solution will confuse students about the expected method signature and will cause compile/test failures if tests expect an int parameter.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across all artifacts. Change the Pneumatic.raisePressure parameter to int in the solution (and implementations) to match the UML/problem statement: void raisePressure(int pressureIncrease). Alternatively, if double is intended, update the UML/problem statement and task descriptions to specify double instead of int.
